body:
Addendum returned inside the standing clock; all three conditional-route conditions hold on complete evidence.

CONDITION ONE (unchanged gate and protected inputs): every snapshot input is byte-for-byte identical to primary main 3cada4b0 - all twenty-four REQUIRED+EXTRA+glob files, the receipt research/analysis/float-plants-pass.json (ff1e5f8c...), the CI workflow, and all five RULES recipe texts (ledgercheck, ledgercheck-selftest, floatplants, floatplantshard, floatplantcheck) hashed from both Makefiles. floatplantcheck ran once this unit and passed: eleven plant-state tests OK, then 'gate contents match the recorded full-plants pass'. Nothing was edited or regenerated.

CONDITION TWO (isolation, demonstrated): the exact final snapshot membership is REQUIRED eleven plus EXTRA five plus the three globs as resolved after the rename - twenty-four files. The four renamed modules match no glob and are absent from the membership, exactly as they are absent from the recorded receipt, whose full-plants pass predates them; that is why the gate now compares equal maps on both sides. Text-search receipts per module name, over the twenty-four membership files, the five recipe texts and the CI workflow (thirty searched spaces), searching both old and new basename and path forms: float_progress zero matches, float_post zero, vacuum_progress zero, vacuum_post zero. No snapshot input or recipe imports, runs or reads any renamed module; with zero references there is no indirection left to trace and no doc mention to contextualize. The one live referencing set is outside the gate: the unit ExecStart argv and four current docs, updated this unit, plus the renamed files themselves.

CONDITION THREE (suites): the existing exactly-three invocations stand unrepeated for this addendum - vacuum_progress suite rc zero with seventy-eight tests OK, vacuum_post suite rc zero with twenty-three tests OK, both counts equal to the pre-rename HEAD counts, then floatplantcheck PASS. Raw streams, rc and durations are in the output root logs.

GATE MATRIX (gate-matrix-u3ns-1018.json, every check member plus ledgercheck-selftest and claimsrestore): ran one - floatplantcheck, with the evidence above. REQUIRED_NOT_RUN nine - fallbackcheck (explicitly required later, CfT153 where browser required, touching path Makefile line one-four-six fresh fallback regeneration), ledgercheck (browser-dependent chain as qualified in the ruling; U3-edited claim docs are touching inputs), ledgercheck-selftest (separate bounded grant), readmecheck, linkcheck, buildercheck, claimscheck, claimsrestore, portcheck (land.py before-Una argv members; linkcheck/claims gates additionally carry the edited doc inputs). Untouched thirty-nine - each with its reason: not in the before-Una argv, zero renamed-module references, no U3-edited path in its recipe; these run under their ordinary separate grants. No required-but-ungranted gate is labeled untouched.

DISPOSITION: on this evidence no actual dependency or unresolved isolation remains, so the conditional supersession conditions are met as measured; the ruling and its Route1 consequence remain the CO's to apply. Remaining after candidate acceptance: the REQUIRED_NOT_RUN set under its separate grants, ledgercheck-selftest, public CI and the four independent plant shards, Una/CO normal governance, figure-free landing title. No new execution, browser, emitter, commit, gate edit or receipt regeneration occurred for this addendum.

ACCOUNTING: same NEW2400 clock, origin 2026-10-18T19:44:07.113595+00:00 / monotonic 1968172.29, never reset; the original closure stood at elapsed 276.56 and this addendum's stamps, final sample and closure are appended to the same ledger inside final_after_writes 2365; known = final + 35.
